summary: Two climbers stranded on the Casual Route (Diamond) on Longs Peak, unprepared for conditions with no self-rescue or bivy gear; NPS rangers stayed in contact overnight and assisted them to the summit and down the north face on July 12. Neither injured.
location: Casual Route (Diamond), Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: ANAC 2024 edition (Pub 2024); report evening Jul 11, assisted down Jul 12; uninjured. Run-585 merge: NPS July-13-2023 release (parent-opened) corroborates — two climbers stranded on the Casual Route (Diamond), East Face of Longs Peak; rangers stayed in contact overnight and assisted them to the summit and down July 12. County corrected Larimer -> Boulder per the Longs Peak = Boulder convention.
